name: Dr. Deb Sandella
reason: Health restore, re-checked under the new rule (12 Nov 2026): her own home page (www.riminstitute.com, read 12 Nov 2026) presents Regenerating Images in Memory (RIM) as a psychotherapy-adjunct technique sold mainly to coaches and therapists (a trauma-informed workshop, an Emotional Physics workshop and a 7-month professional certification, all with CE credits), with individual RIM sessions and a 6-week 'Goodbye, Hurt & Pain' online programme; the home page cites reductions in anxiety and depression and says its results are similar to psychedelic therapy. No meditation, yoga, breath, retreat or other spiritual practice that she leads was found, so it stays out of scope (therapy-method training and sessions).
